name: us-itin-form-w-7
description: How to get or renew a US individual taxpayer identification number on Form W-7 for tax year 2026. Covers who needs an ITIN and who must use an SSN instead, the tax return or the exception that must go with the application, the identity documents, acceptance agents and certifying acceptance agents, the Austin filing address, processing times, and when an unused ITIN expires. Trigger on "ITIN", "Form W-7", "individual taxpayer identification number", "acceptance agent", "certifying acceptance agent", "ITIN renewal", "no Social Security number".
